x: On the other hand, it is written of the wicked, “May his posterity be cut off; may his name be blotted out in the second generation!
They call it sacrifice and awe-inspiring mysteries, not invented ceremonies or idolatry, as these men do. —
He loved the curse—David means the wicked man—and it will come upon him; he did not desire the blessing, and it will depart from him
